### mini_pkg.calc.clamp
```python
def clamp(value, low, high):
    """Clamp value into the inclusive range [low, high]."""
    if value < low:
        return low
    if value > high:
        return high
    return value
```

### mini_pkg.text.display_width
```python
def display_width(s):
    """Return the display width of a string in terminal columns."""
    width = wcswidth(s)
    return len(s) if width < 0 else width
```

### mini_pkg.calc.ceil_div

```python
def ceil_div(a, b):
    """Return ceil(a / b) for positive integers."""
    return (a + b - 1) // b
```

### mini_pkg.text.truncate
```python
def truncate(s, width):
    """Truncate s to at most `width` display columns, adding an ellipsis."""
    if not _needs_truncation(s, width):
        return s
    if width <= 1:
        return "."[:width]
    return s[: width - 1] + "\u2026"
```
